payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and results related to recovering from noisy entity linking in query generation systems.

claims.text: The system can still generate correct answers in 85% of cases despite an 11.4% decline in precision due to noisy entity linking.
Query structures are ranked and validated, allowing the filtering of many erroneous linking results through checks like empty query and domain/range checks.
Merging query substructures improves recall, especially with limited training data, which helps in recovering from noisy linking.
